title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Performing Hajj while doing a job in Saudi Arabia 4239 views Q. My Mother Expired last year(May allah bless him jannah) She was planning to go for Haj this year along with us.(ME My wife,My Father) As she is not more, I would like to take some one for haj e Badal, Some people say that to do haj-e-badal one who has done his haj can only do. Is it compulsory for a person doing haj-e-badal to be haji himself. As I wish to take some poor person along with me, Who has not done haj before. But would like to know from you first. Is it valid for that person to do haj e badal, Though he has not done his haj. Also To my understainding a man can do haj e badal for a woman.(Please correct if I am wrong) 1691 views Q. Entered Haram without Ihraam for Hajj 1998 views Q. Performing Umrah with Mehram/husband. 6381 views Q. Are there any basic conditions for Hajj/Umrah basal? 2145 views Q. I wish to take my mother and wife for HAJJ . But I have some business problems and creditors to pay ( I am writing my problems below in detail) so I am not sure if MY HAJJ WILL BE IN ORDER . I am doing business in the family but due to some disputes our business is on closure and we have bank interest and creditors to pay. I want to settle all the creditors by selling our land to avoid the WRATH OF ALLAH SUBHANAHO TAALAH , but my other associates are not ready for this. As we are all blaming each other for the problems and nobody is interested in settling the business creditors / bank as they all want some money for themselves before they are ready to settle the accounts. The situation is not improving and I want to take my mother and wife for HAJJ with my own personal busines money . Can you please advice, in the light of the Shariat , am I allowed to perform the HAJJ in this situation and will it be in order ? May Allah give you the JAZAA for helping me in this matter. 1928 views Q. Delay the monthly period for purpose of Umrah 6118 views Q. Please give advice. One person making Umrah and after tawaf he removed hair before sa’i unintentionally. He should give dam. Second he is poor financially. Please advise. 2815 views Q. I live in Jeddah with my wife. We went to perform Umra. We completed the Tawaf and Saee. After that, my wife wanted to cut her hair herself but I told her that only someone who has already got Halaqa can cut your hair. She waited for me so I can get my haircut and then cut her hair. After I had my Haircut, we discovered we did not have a scissors to cut her hair. We thought we can go home (Jeddah) and do that. Once we returned home, we kissed each other. Immediately after, she remembered that she needed to cut her hair. Now, please advise us if we should give any "Dum" having done this? If so, what should it be? and can we give Dum back in Pakistan where people need it the most? 9978 views Q. Entering Mecca without Ihram Being Resident of Jeddah,Saudi Arabia 26970 views Q. Intention of Ihram for Umra 2218 views Q. Iztiba in Tawaf 9062 views Q. We are going on Umrah and I want to know is it necessary to shave head hair fully or small cut is enough. 2048 views Q. UMRAH 1979 views Q. I m 43 years old & wanted to do haj-e-badal for my dadajaan,Marhoom Hafiz Manzoor haussain Sb. I have not done Haj for myself so far but intended to do with my wife in future.The expenses for Dadajaan's Haj-e-Badal will be meet by me only. This year my Abba & Ammijaan are also going for Haj for themself & Ihave also applied for Dadajaan's Haj-e Badal. NOW MY QUESTION is- "can do Haj-e-Badal for my Dadajaan taking into considertion of above mentioned fact & circumstances"? 1921 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 697 Country: United States of America Title: What should I do if I crossed the miqat multiple times during Umrah while in hayd without observing the rules of Ihram? Do I need to give damm? Question: Assalamualaikum wa rahmatullah, A few years ago, I went for Umrah. When over there, my hayd started and I was not able to perform Umrah. I went with a group of people and so we went to Madinah and Taif and Al-Ulaa. When we came back from these places we passed through the miqats three different times. I did not know that I am supposed to observe the rules of Ihram even though I was in Hayd so I did all the things such as apply perfume and let cloth touch my face and brushed my hair and some came out,etc. So I just acted like a normal person and never realized I was supposed to observe rules of Ihram. I found out last year about that, so what do I do? Do I have to give damm? Answer ID: 697 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 812=575/H) When you passed by Meeqat for the first time or second time or third time, did you put on Ihraam or you were already in Ihraam? Did you perform any Umrah during this journey? While returning home (US) did you get Halal by cutting a portion of your hair or not? When you went against the rules of Ihraam (like applying perfume, covering face, combing hair with some of then came out etc), before being Halal or after that? First, please write clearly the above points in detail then in-sha-Allah the ruling on damm (slaughtering of animal as fine) will be elaborated. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
